post.full_post:
Be honest: when was the last time you actually drank a glass of water today? 💧

We talk a lot about productivity hacks and high-performance routines, but we often overlook the simplest one: hydration. It's wild how a quick glass of water can clear the brain fog, kill that midday slump, and keep your energy levels steady. You don't need a fancy supplement or another espresso shot—sometimes your brain just needs a little H2O to get back in the zone. Let's make it a habit to keep a bottle on the desk and actually use it.

Drop a 💧 in the comments if you're hydrating right now!
